objective: Independently review Filamajig NFC M1 canonical persistence for migration safety, schema integrity, repository transaction boundaries, provenance retention, shared-spool semantics, and rollback failure modes.
owner_requirements: Preserve all existing saved records, edits, barcode evidence, source attribution, recents, and current app behavior
Persist reusable filament profiles separately from owned physical spools
Retain conflicting observations and prevent provider refresh from overwriting the chosen current value
Allow one profile to serve several physical spools and zero, one, or two tag bindings per spool
Persist transmission-distance current evidence and measurement history
Keep the migration additive and provide a data-preserving rollback path
Do not change NFC serialization, NFC I/O, or printer behavior in this milestone
change_summary: Bumped UserDatabase from v4 to v5 and added profile, observation, override, identifier, physical spool, tag binding, and TD measurement entities with foreign keys and indexes
Added deterministic v4 to v5 backfill while retaining custom_records and recents unchanged
Added LocalFilamentRepository transactions so new local saves and deletes update legacy and canonical persistence together
Added shared-profile-safe deletion and a v5 to v4 rollback migration that drops only canonical tables
Added Room migration and behavior tests for lossless fields/sources, conflicting observations, pinned choices, shared profiles, two tags, dual writes, deletion, and rollback

objective_evidence.regressions: pivot foundation, GTIN index, and package identity verification all PASS

limitations: The built APK has not yet been installed on the 2023 Razr because that phone is not currently listed by ADB
No NFC tag write or U1 operation is required or performed because this change does not touch those paths
The compatibility UI still reads custom_records during the additive transition; canonical inventory UI is a later milestone
review_questions: Can any v4 row lose or misclassify a populated value during backfill?
Can any save, delete, refresh, shared profile, or tag-binding operation violate identity or user-choice invariants?
Does the rollback preserve every pre-v5 table and value, and are schema/migration definitions exactly aligned with Room?
What concrete defect must be corrected before real-device migration acceptance?
sanitization: No credentials, environment values, private device data, tag UIDs, or user database contents are included.
